in_marathi.name: Majibur
in_marathi.long_meaning: Majibur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'majha' (great) and 'bhu' (earth). Signifies someone who is great and victorious in their pursuits.
